step1_pattern.operation: 净利润（含少数股东）÷ 平均总资产
notes: GT 定义为 "Average Total Assets"，但 2023 年实际用了期末总资产

step5_question.question: Using Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what was P&G's return on assets (ROA) for fiscal 2026, and how does it compare with fiscal 2025? Define ROA = net earnings (including noncontrolling interests) / average total assets, where average total assets is the mean of the beginning- and end-of-year balances. Report both as percentages rounded to one decimal place and state whether ROA increased or decreased.
changes_vs_seed: 两年统一用平均总资产（原题 2023 年口径不一致）

step2_verdict: SEED_ERROR（口径不一致）。GT 写明 ROA = 净利润 ÷ 平均总资产，FY2024 按此计算（12.3，复现）；FY2023 实际用了期末总资产：14,738 ÷ 120,829 = 12.20（与 GT 12.2 一致），按平均总资产应为 14,738 ÷ ((117,208 + 120,829)/2) = 12.4。

notes: 回测标记源于原题口径不一致，不是 pipeline 错误；新题两年统一用 GT 自己写明的平均总资产口径
